name: Yam Pudding
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: white sugar
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of white sugar

ingredients.name: a pint of cream or half a pound of butter
ingredients.originalText: a pint of cream or half a pound of butter
ingredients.quantityText: a pint of cream or half a pound of butter

ingredients.name: wine glass of rose water
ingredients.originalText: a wine glass of rose water

ingredients.name: mashed potato
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of mashed potato

instructions.text: Take one pound of roasted yam, and rub it through a cullender
Mix with it half a pound of white sugar, a pint of cream or half a pound of butter, a tea-spoonful of powdered cinnamon, a grated nutmeg, and a wine glass of rose water, and one of wine
Set it away to get cold
Beat eight eggs very light, and add them by degrees to the mixture, alternately with half a pound of the mashed potato
Bake it three-quarters of an hour in a buttered dish

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take one pound of roasted yam, and rub it through a cullender
2. Mix with it half a pound of white sugar, a pint of cream or half a pound of butter, a tea-spoonful of powdered cinnamon, a grated nutmeg, and a wine glass of rose water, and one of wine
3. Set it away to get cold
4. Beat eight eggs very light, and add them by degrees to the mixture, alternately with half a pound of the mashed potato
5. Bake it three-quarters of an hour in a buttered dish
